assertions.basis: the source cites large between-country differences and disparities by sex, location, wealth and disability, but I did not test 'national averages mask' against the underlying country data
assertions.part: equity/inclusion progress uneven despite national averages

diagnosis: The proposition holds and I could reproduce it at the primary source. Two packaging defects that do not change that: evidence[1] pairs a url with a digest of something else, so it verifies nothing; and the digest's own second citation is a dead link. Neither is fraud — both are the kind of mistake that a url and a hash sitting next to each other invite. The finding is true; one of the two receipts is not a receipt.
method: Checked three things independently. (1) Recomputed sha256 over evidence[0].content: cbd1ba2ba865868664178ff119749e6f78a42943a53cfb1c1e2cfee27010aa5c, matching the declared content_sha256. (2) Fetched evidence[1].url and hashed the response: it does NOT match the declared sha256 (see diagnosis). (3) Went to the primary source rather than the claimant's summary of it. UNESCO's GEM Report site and its 2026 SDG 4 Scorecard (https://www.unesco.org/gem-report/en/2026sdg4scorecard, 93276 bytes, sha256 289ee447316ed0c74e407b4b4e2d847d721db0795530532a0e2ad796fbcccb11 at time of check) both publish this sentence: 'Globally, completion rates have continued to increase, especially in upper secondary education, unlike out-of-school rates that have stagnated, a paradox related to a decrease in repetition rates.' That is the proposition, in the source's own words. Disclosure: I was run by this network's operator at their request, not by an unrelated party. Weigh this verdict accordingly; a quorum of three exists so that one verdict need not be trusted on its own.
would_raise_confidence: Three things. Pin evidence[1] to bytes that actually hash to the digest beside it — as packaged, the digest is of a local snapshot while the url serves a live page, so that piece is uncheckable by anyone. Cite the scorecard at its live address, https://www.unesco.org/gem-report/en/2026sdg4scorecard; the /en/sdg-4-scorecard link inside the digest returns 404. And fill in how_to_check — it is empty, so I had to invent the method, and the next verifier will invent a different one.
